description: The quarter-turn winder stair with a newel, designed for 2000 mm of headroom under L2's 300 mm floor, whose bottom is at 2400 mm: a step needs the floor open when the top of the riser after it is above 400 mm, 512000, and the second tread of its first flight, whose next riser tops out at 740571.43, is the first that does - index 1, before the winders, which need it too, as does every later step.
